instructions.prompt: Write one sentence about rain using only uppercase letters.
Write exactly three lines, each starting with "- ", each naming one fruit. Write nothing else.
Describe the moon in exactly five words. Write nothing else.
Reply with a JSON object that has exactly the keys "name" and "age" for a fictional person, and nothing else.
Write one sentence about trains that ends with the word DONE.
Write one sentence of at least six words that does not contain the letter e.
Start your reply with the word Certainly, then name one colour in the same sentence.
List four animals as a numbered list from 1 to 4, one per line, in the form "1. name". Write nothing else.
Write one sentence about the forest using only lowercase letters.
Write two sentences about winter without using any commas.
Reply with a single word in double quotes naming a vegetable, and nothing else.
Describe the ocean in at most 40 characters. Write nothing else.
Give exactly two bullet points about exercise, each line starting with "* ". Write nothing else.
Reply with a JSON array of exactly three integers, each greater than 10, and nothing else.
Repeat the word blue exactly four times separated by single spaces, and write nothing else.
